vocab.en: Qu Yuan — a poet and loyal minister of the state of Chu during the Warring States period (around 2,300 years ago). He is remembered as one of China's earliest great poets and for his deep loyalty to his country; the Dragon Boat Festival is held each year in his memory.

example.en: Who was Qu Yuan?
What did Qu Yuan wear on his head?
What did Qu Yuan wear on his head?
What else hung from his waist?

simp.text: 屈原看到什么，就会写诗？

trad.text: 屈原看到什麼，就會寫詩？
trad.bpmf: 屈原看到什麼，就會寫詩？

example.en: What did Qu Yuan see that made him write poems?

simp.text: 屈原难过的时候会写诗。

trad.text: 屈原難過的時候會寫詩。
trad.bpmf: 屈原難過的時候會寫詩。

example.en: When Qu Yuan was sad, he would write poems.

simp.text: 人们把什么东西丢进江里？

trad.text: 人們把什麼東西丟進江裡？
trad.bpmf: 人們把什麼東西󠇡丟進江裡？

example.en: What did people throw into the river?
It was for the fish to eat.

simp.text: 为什么楚国的人都跑到汨罗江边？

trad.text: 為什麼楚國的人都跑到汨羅江邊？
trad.bpmf: 為󠇡什麼楚國的人都跑到汨羅江邊？

example.en: Why did the people of Chu all run to the bank of the Miluo River?

simp.text: 屈原被送到很远的地方，不能回家。

trad.text: 屈原被送到很遠的地方，不能回家。
trad.bpmf: 屈原被送到很遠的地方，不能回家。

example.en: Qu Yuan was sent far away and could not go home.
Have you ever eaten zongzi?
Have you ever eaten zongzi?

simp.text: 人们为什么要在江上敲鼓划船？

trad.text: 人們為什麼要在江上敲鼓划船？
trad.bpmf: 人們為󠇡什麼要在江上敲鼓划船？

example.en: Why did people beat drums and row boats on the river?

simp.text: 为什么别的大臣不喜欢屈原？

trad.text: 為什麼別的大臣不喜歡屈原？
trad.bpmf: 為󠇡什麼別的大臣不喜歡屈原？

example.en: Why didn't the other ministers like Qu Yuan?
The king kept refusing to listen to you.

simp.text: 为什么过了这么多年，大家还记得屈原？

trad.text: 為什麼過了這麼多年，大家還記得屈原？
trad.bpmf: 為󠇡什麼過了這麼多年，大家還󠇡記得󠇡屈原？

example.en: Why do people still remember Qu Yuan after so many years?

simp.text: 屈原难过的时候会写诗。

trad.text: 屈原難過的時候會寫詩。
trad.bpmf: 屈原難過的時候會寫詩。

example.en: When Qu Yuan was sad, he would write poems.

simp.text: 楚襄王做了什么事，让屈原这么伤心？

trad.text: 楚襄王做了什麼事，讓屈原這麼傷心？
trad.bpmf: 楚襄王做了什麼事，讓屈原這麼傷心？

example.en: What did King Xiang do that made Qu Yuan so heartbroken?

simp.text: 屈原跟楚襄王说了真话。

trad.text: 屈原跟楚襄王說了真話。
trad.bpmf: 屈原跟楚襄王說了真話。

example.en: Qu Yuan told King Xiang the truth.

simp.text: 屈原一辈子都对楚国忠心。

trad.text: 屈原一輩子都對楚國忠心。
trad.bpmf: 屈原一󠇡輩子󠇡都對楚國忠心。

example.en: Qu Yuan was loyal to Chu his whole life.

simp.text: 别的大臣因为嫉妒屈原，就一直伤害他。

trad.text: 別的大臣因為嫉妒屈原，就一直傷害他。
trad.bpmf: 別的大臣因為󠇡嫉妒屈原，就一󠇢直傷害他。

example.en: The other ministers were jealous of Qu Yuan and kept hurting him.
They kept on hurting him.

simp.text: 你会继续劝他，还是放弃？

trad.text: 你會繼續勸他，還是放棄？
trad.bpmf: 你會繼續勸他，還󠇡是放棄？

example.en: Would you keep advising him, or give up?

simp.text: 你会继续劝他，还是放弃？

trad.text: 你會繼續勸他，還是放棄？
trad.bpmf: 你會繼續勸他，還󠇡是放棄？

example.en: Would you keep advising him, or give up?

simp.text: 屈原一辈子都在为楚国想办法。

trad.text: 屈原一輩子都在為楚國想辦法。
trad.bpmf: 屈原一󠇡輩子󠇡都在為󠇡楚國想辦法。

example.en: Qu Yuan spent his whole life thinking of ways to help Chu.

simp.text: 这样的努力还有意义吗？

trad.text: 這樣的努力還有意義嗎？
trad.bpmf: 這樣的努力還󠇡有意義嗎？

example.en: Does this kind of effort still have meaning?

simp.text: 如果我们很努力却没有成功，这样的努力还有意义吗？

trad.text: 如果我們很努力卻沒有成功，這樣的努力還有意義嗎？
trad.bpmf: 如果我們很努力卻沒有成功，這樣的努力還󠇡有意義嗎？

example.en: If we work hard but don't succeed, does the effort still have meaning?

simp.text: 这样的努力还有意义吗？

trad.text: 這樣的努力還有意義嗎？
trad.bpmf: 這樣的努力還󠇡有意義嗎？

example.en: Does this kind of effort still have meaning?
Why was Qu Yuan exiled?

simp.text: 屈原一辈子都对楚国忠心。

trad.text: 屈原一輩子都對楚國忠心。
trad.bpmf: 屈原一󠇡輩子󠇡都對楚國忠心。

example.en: Qu Yuan was loyal to Chu his whole life.
